cases.document_text: The team should ship the verifier if evidence is present.

annotations.label: promise

span.text: should ship the verifier if evidence is present

notes: Modal 'should' marks a recommendation, not a promise.

annotations.label: review_commitment
notes: Keep the review action separate from the modal recommendation.

annotations.label: team_membership
notes: Do not infer any individual membership from sentence adjacency.

cases.document_text: Alice promised to ship the report tomorrow. The team will review the draft before Friday.

annotations.label: promise

span.text: promised to ship the report tomorrow

notes: This is an explicit promise, not a recommendation.

annotations.label: review_commitment

span.text: will review the draft before Friday

notes: The review action is a separate commitment from the promise.

annotations.label: antecedent_resolution
notes: The antecedent for the promise is explicit.

annotations.label: team_membership
notes: Do not assume Alice is part of the team from the previous sentence.
